points.title: 贵族教育
points.description: 安托万·拉瓦锡出生于巴黎一个富裕的贵族家庭。他在马萨林学院接受教育，学习法律、文学和科学。尽管他按照家族期望获得了法学学位，但他的真正兴趣在于科学。这一时期，他接触了当时最前沿的科学思想，包括法国启蒙运动的影响，为他后来的科学研究奠定了基础。他的家庭背景使他能够获得良好的教育资源和学术人脉，这对他的科学事业至关重要。
points.descriptionEn: Antoine Lavoisier was born in Paris into a wealthy aristocratic family. He received his education at the Collège Mazarin, studying law, literature, and sciences. Despite obtaining a law degree as his family expected, his true passion lay in science. During this period, he was exposed to the most advanced scientific ideas of the time, including the influence of the French Enlightenment, which laid the foundation for his later scientific research. His family background provided him with excellent educational resources and academic connections, which proved crucial for his scientific career.

points.title: 科学研究起步
points.description: 拉瓦锡开始专注于科学研究，特别是在地质学和化学领域。他进行了地质考察，绘制了法国地质图，并发表了关于地质学的论文。同时，他开始研究燃烧现象，挑战当时流行的燃素说。他精确测量了化学反应前后的质量，提出了质量守恒定律的早期形式。这一时期，他还加入了法国科学院，成为其最年轻的成员之一，并与当时的著名科学家如布莱克、普利斯特里等人建立了学术联系。
points.descriptionEn: Lavoisier began to focus on scientific research, particularly in geology and chemistry. He conducted geological surveys, mapped the geology of France, and published papers on geology. Simultaneously, he started studying combustion phenomena, challenging the prevailing phlogiston theory. He precisely measured the mass before and after chemical reactions, proposing an early form of the law of conservation of mass. During this period, he also joined the French Academy of Sciences, becoming one of its youngest members, and established academic connections with prominent scientists of the time such as Black and Priestley.

points.title: 化学革命
points.description: 这是拉瓦锡科学成就最辉煌的时期。他进行了著名的氧气实验，推翻了燃素说，建立了氧化理论。他发明了命名化学物质的新系统，提出了化学元素的概念，并编写了第一部现代化学教科书《化学纲要》。同时，他担任了法国火药和硝石管理局的局长，改革了火药生产，提高了法国的军事能力。他还参与了法国度量衡改革，提出了十进制计量系统。这一时期，他的实验室成为欧洲科学中心，吸引了众多年轻科学家前来学习。
points.descriptionEn: This was the most glorious period of Lavoisier's scientific achievements. He conducted his famous oxygen experiments,推翻了(phlogiston theory), and established the theory of oxidation. He invented a new system for naming chemical substances, proposed the concept of chemical elements, and wrote the first modern chemistry textbook, 'Elements of Chemistry'. At the same time, he served as the director of the French Gunpowder and Saltpeter Administration, reforming gunpowder production and enhancing France's military capabilities. He also participated in the French reform of weights and measures, proposing the decimal system. During this period, his laboratory became a European scientific center, attracting many young scientists to study there.

points.title: 大革命时期
points.description: 法国大革命爆发后，拉瓦锡的处境变得复杂。他作为旧制度的既得利益者，担任了多个政府职位，包括税收官，这使他成为革命者的目标。然而，他也积极参与改革，参与了法国科学院的重组，并试图保护科学机构免受革命冲击。他继续科学研究，但面临越来越多的政治压力。这一时期，他完成了《化学纲要》的第二版，并开始研究农业化学，试图通过科学方法提高农业生产。他的政治立场使他处于危险之中，尽管他试图通过支持革命来保护自己和科学事业。
points.descriptionEn: After the outbreak of the French Revolution, Lavoisier's situation became complicated. As a beneficiary of the old regime, he held several government positions, including tax farmer, which made him a target of revolutionaries. However, he also actively participated in reforms, participated in the reorganization of the French Academy of Sciences, and tried to protect scientific institutions from the impact of the revolution. He continued his scientific research but faced increasing political pressure. During this period, he completed the second edition of 'Elements of Chemistry' and began studying agricultural chemistry, attempting to improve agricultural production through scientific methods. His political position put him in danger, although he tried to protect himself and his scientific career by supporting the revolution.

points.title: 悲剧结局
points.description: 1793年，拉瓦锡被革命政府逮捕，尽管他的科学贡献巨大，但他的税收官身份成为致命的指控。在审判中，他被指控为'人民公敌'和'税收欺诈者'，尽管缺乏实质证据。1794年5月8日，拉瓦锡被送上断头台，年仅51岁。据说，著名数学家拉格朗日曾感叹：'砍下他的头只需要一瞬间，但法国需要一个世纪才能再长出这样一颗头。'他的死被视为科学界的一大悲剧，也反映了法国大革命中极端政治对理性的压制。他的妻子玛丽-安娜继承了他的工作，并整理出版了他的遗著。
points.descriptionEn: In 1793, Lavoisier was arrested by the revolutionary government. Despite his enormous scientific contributions, his position as a tax farmer became a fatal accusation. During his trial, he was charged with being an 'enemy of the people' and 'tax fraud', although there was little substantial evidence. On May 8, 1794, Lavoisier was guillotined at the age of 51. It is said that the famous mathematician Lagrange lamented: 'It took them only an instant to cut off his head, but France may not produce another such head in a century.' His death was seen as a great tragedy for the scientific community and reflected the suppression of reason by extreme politics during the French Revolution. His wife, Marie-Anne, inherited his work and published his posthumous works.

supporter.zh: 拉瓦锡被誉为'现代化学之父'，他的科学贡献彻底改变了化学领域。他建立了科学的化学命名系统，提出了质量守恒定律，推翻了错误的燃素说，建立了氧化理论。他的严谨实验方法和定量分析为现代化学奠定了基础。拉瓦锡不仅是一位杰出的科学家，还是一位科学组织者，他改革了法国的科学教育体系，促进了科学知识的传播。他的工作使化学从一门神秘的技艺转变为精确的科学，对后世科学发展产生了深远影响。
supporter.en: Lavoisier is hailed as the 'Father of Modern Chemistry' whose scientific contributions revolutionized the field. He established a scientific system for naming chemical substances, proposed the law of conservation of mass, overthrew the erroneous phlogiston theory, and established the theory of oxidation. His rigorous experimental methods and quantitative analysis laid the foundation for modern chemistry. Lavoisier was not only an outstanding scientist but also a scientific organizer who reformed France's scientific education system and promoted the dissemination of scientific knowledge. His work transformed chemistry from a mysterious craft into an exact science, having a profound impact on the development of science in later generations.

critic.zh: 批评者指出拉瓦锡作为旧制度的既得利益者，担任税收官等职务，剥削了普通民众。他在大革命中的立场摇摆，试图通过支持革命来保护自己，最终未能逃脱命运。此外，他的一些科学观点也存在局限性，如对热的本质理解不足，对某些化学反应的解释也有缺陷。他的悲剧结局部分源于他与政治的复杂关系，反映了科学家在政治动荡中的脆弱性。批评者认为，拉瓦锡虽然科学成就卓著，但在道德和政治立场上存在争议。
critic.en: Critics point out that as a beneficiary of the old regime, Lavoisier held positions such as tax farmer, exploiting ordinary people. His position during the Revolution was wavering; he tried to protect himself by supporting the revolution but ultimately failed to escape his fate. Additionally, some of his scientific views had limitations, such as insufficient understanding of the nature of heat and defects in explaining certain chemical reactions. His tragic end was partly due to his complex relationship with politics, reflecting the vulnerability of scientists during political turmoil. Critics argue that although Lavoisier had outstanding scientific achievements, he had controversies in his moral and political positions.

objective.zh: 从历史角度看，拉瓦锡代表了科学革命的关键人物，他的工作标志着化学从炼金术向现代科学的转变。在流行文化中，他被塑造成科学理性与政治暴力冲突的象征。历史学界普遍认为，拉瓦锡的悲剧结局反映了法国大革命中极端政治对理性的压制，同时也揭示了科学进步与社会变革之间的复杂关系。他的科学方法强调精确测量和实验验证，这一理念至今仍是科学研究的核心。拉瓦锡的故事成为科学史上关于科学、政治与道德关系的经典案例，提醒人们科学成就与社会责任之间的平衡。
objective.en: From a historical perspective, Lavoisier represents a key figure in the scientific revolution, and his work marked the transformation of chemistry from alchemy to modern science. In popular culture, he has been portrayed as a symbol of the conflict between scientific rationality and political violence. The historical community generally believes that Lavoisier's tragic end reflects the suppression of reason by extreme politics during the French Revolution, while also revealing the complex relationship between scientific progress and social change. His scientific methods emphasizing precise measurement and experimental verification remain core to scientific research to this day. Lavoisier's story has become a classic case in the history of science regarding the relationship between science, politics, and morality, reminding people of the balance between scientific achievements and social responsibility.

self.zh: 在科学中，事实必须取代想象。
self.en: In chemistry, facts must replace imagination.

others.zh: 砍下他的头只需要一瞬间，但法国需要一个世纪才能再长出这样一颗头。
others.en: It took them only an instant to cut off his head, but France may not produce another such head in a century.
